title: Two Selves
coreMove: ask whether you are optimizing the lived moment or the memory that will later judge it
sourcePressure: introduces the experiencing self and the remembering self as partly different judges of life
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: splitting the self into therapy personas instead of two evaluative standpoints

hook: opening with a named bias definition for Two Selves
starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar
counterintuition: the obvious advice is simply slow down
smart people are immune if they know the term
tryThisNow: write three lessons in a journal
examples: student in a classroom guessing an answer

exampleSpecs.domain: courtroom jury pool facing a decision distorted by experiencing self
exampleSpecs.audience: a lead or reviewer who must ask whether you are optimizing the lived moment or the memory that will later judge it while others want the quick answer
exampleSpecs.stakes: the visible call will go wrong unless experiencing self is separated from the tempting but weaker cue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the operator places the jury questionnaire stack labeled experiencing self beside the tempting first answer, covers the answer field with a palm, and speaks the correction: ask whether you are optimizing the lived moment or the memory that will later judge it
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The first thing in the room is the texture of the jury questionnaire stack labeled experiencing self, not the person's opinion about it.
mustInclude: jury questionnaire stack labeled experiencing self
